claims: The Artemis II mission will reach speeds of approximately 17,000 mph (27,000 km/h) to enter Earth orbit.
The Orion capsule will hit a peak reentry speed of over 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h) during its return from the Moon.
The Orion capsule's peak reentry speed is roughly 32 times the speed of sound.
The Orion capsule's reentry is one of the fastest human-rated reentries.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket accelerates to over 3,100 mph within the first two minutes.
The rocket hits around 17,000 mph to reach orbit during orbit injection.
Further burns increase the speed to over 22,000 mph to escape Earth's gravity during trans-lunar injection.
The spacecraft hits the atmosphere at 25,000 mph during reentry.
The Artemis II crew will technically become the fastest-traveling humans in history upon their return.
The Artemis II crew will surpass the speeds of Apollo 10.
